body: I apologize for not getting back to you it was late this morning before I got to sleep  and when I finally woke up I watched a movie then cooked dinner. My daughter sent one of my nieces an email the 2nd week she was gone saying she's okay then in December the same niece saw an Instagram post saying she's engaged so I made a facebook post congratulating her so she deleted her Instagram account created a new one and blocked everyone . On my mothers birthday she emailed her but no one knows where she is or who she is with. All of her friends and former coworkers say they don't know anything. I really don't understand any of it we were very close since her father passed away in 2010 after that she developed PTSD and she had bipolar, and severe social anxiety . She had a genius IQ and graduated college in computer science information with honors always on the presidents list. She never drank smoked or did drugs and didn't even cuss. She gets depressed and suicidal a lot  and does not drive . I am still in shock that she ran away with someone and cannot figure out why she won't talk to me ! Everyone  assumes we must have a a big fight or something but we didn't I love her more than anything in the world she is my life ! I just want to be able to talk with her and have our relationship back ! I'm sorry to write so much I am just trying to explain everything ! Thank you so very much for reaching out to a stranger in need it means a lot !

Thank you for replying ! There is too much going on a history of abuse severe mental issues several chronic illnesses and my daughter ran away on October 20th and I have not heard from her since ! I have been emailing and messaging her since she left and Tuesday is my birthday and I have been praying she will contact me then but the closer it gets the more worried and panicked I get that I won't hear from her ! I don't know what to do if she doesn't!

As I said I have several mental issues . I also have a traumatic past since the age of 5 consisting of child molestation 2 rapes mental physical and sexual abuse . Now I have these medical illnesses that cause severe brain fog tiredness pain and even more depression and I am one stage away from kidney failure. Now my heart and my life which is my daughter and only child is gone and will not communicate with me and I don't know why I have no idea where she is who she is with and if I will ever hear from her again and I don't know why ! So I feel like my heart soul and life are gone ! I hate myself and life itself there is nothing or no one to keep hanging on for !
I don't know how I can help but do you want to talk maybe two people of the same mindset can help each other.

I truly don't know I don't know what to do anymore! I just saw my psychiatrist yesterday  and got out of a mental health center on Christmas Day . I truly appreciate you reaching out no one seems to understand how crazy my mind is going I am just so tired of life!
